activation: diagnostic and formal modes require a separate Owner policy-approval file binding this config SHA-256

workload.prefix_policy: B=8 and B=32 use prefixes of the same ordered 128-query buffer; B=128 uses the complete buffer

candidate_space.diagnostic_selection: lowest valid Prepared E2E median per (N,B); ties select smaller query_tile, then smaller block_size

proposed_policy.bootstrap_prng: FNV-1a-32 identity mix initialized with seed 2166136261, then Numerical-Recipes LCG state=1664525*state+1013904223 modulo 2^32
proposed_policy.diagnostic_candidate_order: for workload ordinal w and iteration i, visit all nine lexicographically ordered (query_tile,block_size) candidates in cyclic order beginning at (w+i) mod 9
proposed_policy.formal_lane_order: for workload ordinal w and iteration i, visit CPU Raw, V5 Raw, V5 Prepared, and V5 Kernel in cyclic order beginning at (w+i) mod 4
proposed_policy.schema_family: V5-BATCH-*-v1 with explicit phase, revision, tree state, config/freeze/correctness identity, timing boundary, and environment identity fields

timing_boundaries.CPU-BATCH-RAW: existing CPU Float32 batch API entry through synchronous host result return; dataset and query validation included
timing_boundaries.V5-BATCH-RAW: V5 raw one-shot API entry through synchronous host batch result return, including validation, layout construction, allocations, transfers, kernels, synchronization, and call-owned cleanup
timing_boundaries.V5-BATCH-PREPARED: V5 prepared synchronous API entry through host result return with prepared dataset and compatible workspace reused; validation, query/result transfers, kernels, and synchronization included; persistent destruction excluded
timing_boundaries.V5-BATCH-KERNEL: CUDA events after query H2D and before result D2H around the complete V5 distance and final-reduction kernel sequence on device-resident prepared state
timing_boundaries.V5-PREPARED-DATASET-CONSTRUCTION: V5 dataset preparation entry through synchronous return; persistent destruction excluded
timing_boundaries.V5-WORKSPACE-CONSTRUCTION: V5 workspace construction entry through synchronous return; persistent destruction excluded
timing_boundaries.V5-PREPARED-READY-CONSTRUCTION: V5 dataset preparation entry through compatible workspace construction return; persistent destruction excluded

primary_comparison.speedup: CPU Batch Raw median / GPU V5 Raw median
primary_comparison.experiment_pass: all 12 workloads pass and completeness, identity, correctness, telemetry, and environment gates are accepted

break_even.persistent_resource_destruction: excluded; not a complete lifetime cost

historical_evidence_policy: S14/S15 inputs may be reused when compatible; historical results and artifacts are immutable
